title: "Learn on Start + Void"
description: "Qualify the native Learn Worker for the canonical host and apex mount, capture routing and prepare rollback."
updatedAt: "2026-11-20"
audience: developers
---

`apps/learn` has native TanStack Start + Vite+ + Void source beside its Next build,
generated by the [start-bridge codemod](/build/devops/start-bridge-codemod). Capture
the serving deployment for each URL before activation.

## Worker

- `apps/learn/void.config.ts` names the staging candidate (`workers_dev` on, `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX=1`). The production archive targets `tuturuuu-learn` with `workers_dev` and `preview_urls` off, `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX=0` and no configured routes.
- Entry: `apps/learn/cloudflare/worker.ts`; Wrangler config is emitted by `void` into `dist`.
- Root host: `learn.tuturuuu.com` (compiled in `start-bridge.config.ts` or the generated default).
- Mount: `tuturuuu.com/learn` (base path `/learn`), served by the same Worker.
- Binding: `ASSETS` (static output, `run_worker_first`).
- Variables (names): `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX`, optional `INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN` (default `https://tuturuuu.com`).
- Secrets (names, set in the Worker, never in the repo): `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`,
  `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`,
  `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET`. Compare with the Vercel project
  environment list before the flip.

## Document script policy

The Learn Worker enforces a fresh request nonce with `strict-dynamic` on both
`learn.tuturuuu.com` and `tuturuuu.com/learn`. The full document policy, including
Trusted Types, is report-only. Theme and Sorbet prepaint scripts receive the
request nonce during server rendering; client rendering omits it. The router
and bridge head scripts use the same request context. Regression coverage lives
in `apps/learn/start-bridge.config.test.ts` and the client-provider SSR and
hydration tests.

Runtime qualification requires the owning CI build and its package outputs.
A fresh source-only worktree can fail module resolution before serving a request;
that failure does not establish the root or mounted route's HTTP status. Preserve
the expected `200` assertions and qualify the emitted Worker in CI.

## Build and qualification

```bash
bun turbo:local run build --filter=@tuturuuu/learn^... --concurrency=2
bun scripts/ci/generate-build-metadata.ts
bun run --cwd apps/learn routes:check
bun run --cwd apps/learn type-check:cloudflare
bun run --cwd apps/learn build:cloudflare
CI=true CI_SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) bun run --cwd apps/learn test:runtime
```

`learn-cloudflare.yaml` runs the same steps in CI. The cutover job also runs the
emitted production Worker in workerd, seals the tested bytes and repeats the
cutover probes after restoring the archive in a clean checkout. Both URL variants
must render the landing page with a bare-path query, serve its emitted assets,
and preserve the full parent-invite destination through the Web login and
verification redirects. The mounted Worker rejects attempts to mint an app
session. Runtime credentials and outbound API responses use fixtures.

## Private smoke and route watch

```bash
curl -sI https://learn.tuturuuu.com/api/build-info      # 200, JSON, no-store
curl -sI https://learn.tuturuuu.com/                    # entry route, see below
curl -sI https://learn.tuturuuu.com/login               # renders, no 5xx
curl -sI https://learn.tuturuuu.com/robots.txt          # 200
curl -sI 'https://tuturuuu.com/learn?x=1&x=2'            # landing page
curl -sI https://tuturuuu.com/learn/api/build-info       # same commit as the subdomain
```

Before routing, upload the sealed bytes at zero traffic and run the same checks
against the pinned version. With an approved smoke identity, open a course and a
parent-invite fixture, read the timetable, save and remove a disposable progress
record, and verify an API call that falls through to Web. Repeat on both URL
variants. After activation, watch errors, redirects, asset status and sign-in for
30–60 minutes and roll back immediately on regression.

## Rollback

1. Record the immutable deployment and route, custom-domain and DNS readback
   for `learn.tuturuuu.com`. Record the serving gateway version and its mount
   configuration for `tuturuuu.com`.
2. Include only `/learn` and `/learn/*` in the gateway change, using
   `MOUNT_LEARN` bound to `tuturuuu-learn`. Restore the captured gateway version
   in one operation if the mount regresses. Retain the serving canonical deployment
   and its route rollback for an independent subdomain cutover.
3. Verify Web handles the apex paths again after mount rollback. After canonical
   rollback, verify the retained deployment responds on the subdomain.

Rolling back touches no database rows and no migrations. Route, DNS and deployment
changes belong to the release owner.
